name: Philadelphia Experiment
description: An alleged 1943 U.S. Navy experiment said to have rendered the destroyer escort USS Eldridge invisible — and briefly teleported it from Philadelphia to Norfolk — based on Einstein's unified field theory. The story is widely regarded as a hoax originating with letters by Carl M. Allen in 1955–56.

aliases.name: Project Rainbow
aliases.meaning: Name used in conspiracy literature for the alleged experiment

origin: The alleged event is associated with two real U.S. locations — the Philadelphia Naval Shipyard, Pennsylvania, and Norfolk, Virginia — but the story has no verified geographic occurrence.
